title: PS5 and Xbox US sales hit historic lows 📉
subject: consoles
description:
Would you pay $600 for a console? 👇

Circana's Mat Piscatella says the US console hardware market is at its most precarious since the early 80s. Through August 2026, Xbox hardware unit sales are down 33% and PlayStation down 25%, while average prices paid hit all-time highs of $529 and $597.

Sources: Circana / Mat Piscatella via VGC (Oct 10, 2026)

scenes.text: US console hardware hasn't been this shaky since the 80s.
scenes.search: game console controller close up dark

scenes.text: That's the warning from Circana analyst Mat Piscatella.
Through August, Xbox hardware unit sales in the US are down 33% this year, an all-time low for the platform.
PlayStation is down 25%, its lowest point since 2013.
The reason is price. The average Xbox now sells for $529, and the average PlayStation for $597, both all-time US highs.
Piscatella says GTA 6 in November could ease some of the decline, if consoles stay in stock.
